text:
incident-bot: Automated page fired: LATENCY_SLO_BURN — p99 = 4.8s (threshold 4.0s). service=inference-api region=us-west env=prod
pagerduty: PagerDuty incident created and routed to on-call, escalation policy=primary-oncall
chris: ack'd. I'm on it. grabbing graphs now :eyes:
anna: I'm joining. any immediate customer reports?
support-bot: New alert: 11 customer-facing errors flagged in last 5m (frontend timeouts). Ticket++
samir: Grafana link: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/latency/inference-api?from=now-15m
samir: p95 jumped to 1.8s, p99 4.8s, request rate +18% — batch histogram shows heavier long-tail for token lengths >512
chris: logs show increased queuing at sidecar batcher, a few workers at 100% GPU util, some OOM evictions in the sidecar logs
anna: Could be the new canary model with increased batch_size deployed to us-west-canary. Anyone rolled canary up recently?
chris: yeah, canary deployed ~10m ago. It increases batching to 64 for throughput. Rolling it back now. Command: kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/inference-canary
ops-bot: rollout undo started for deployment/inference-canary — revision: previous stable
chris: Also scaling replica pool to absorb burst: kubectl -n prod scale deployment/inference-sidecar --replicas=12
samir: I prefer a traffic diversion first — route a % of traffic to dedicated fallback (us-west-fallback) while rollback completes. Updating routing policy:
```
route set inference-api --region us-west --weight fallback=30 primary=70
```
anna: Good. That should reduce tail while we confirm cache warmups. Clearing prefix KV cache on a few nodes to avoid stale large-req entries: `redis-cli -h kvcache-12 FLUSHDB` (doing in sequence)
chris: p95 down to 1.4s after traffic diversion + rollback started. p99 still 3.9s though.
support-bot: Support update: incoming CS tickets slowing, but no wide customer outage reported. Notifying customers with affected latency note.
chris: pushing a temporary throttle on large requests (>1024 tokens) to protect SLOs: feature-flagging request_size_limit=1024
samir: I'm taking incident lead — handoff from chris. Creating incident doc INC-2026-451 and postmortem stub.
samir: Next steps: finish canary rollback, monitor KV cache eviction rate, evaluate canary batch_size config, and decide whether to keep fallback route for 1h.
anna: adding follow-up checklist to INC-2026-451: 1) confirm rollback fully rolled 2) roll back batching config in model onboarding 3) backfill any lost telemetry 4) postmortem owner assigned
chris: thanks — handoff complete. I'll stay on standby for telemetry validation. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-451 created. Severity: S2. Current status: mitigated (traffic diversion + rollback).
samir: closing active page rotation; will update on timeline in the incident doc. If p99 rises again, re-open page.
chris: confirmed last check p99=2.0s and trending down. signing off from active mitigation, handing to samir for followups.
